ai_summary: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL) reported a highly successful Q2 FY27, marking its fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth (11% YoY) and more than doubling its Net Profit (PAT up 126% YoY). This robust performance was materially impacted by significant EBITDA margin expansion to 17.2%, strong retail like-to-like growth, accelerated network expansion with over 100 new stores, and impressive 27% revenue growth in its Emerging Businesses portfolio, alongside a reduction in net debt. The document presents no apparent red flags, showcasing strong operational leverage and effective strategic execution.
